item.title: Eddie is a no-go as season holding period ends
item.description: The Rip Curl Eddie Aikau Big Wave Invitational is a no-go this season, with waves and conditions not meeting requirements, according to organizers.

item.title: EDITORIAL: Don’t waffle on Maui STR phaseout
item.description: The Maui County Council’s zig-zag approach to seeking adequate affordable housing has been a thing to behold — with growing frustration. It’s latest “shoot, then retreat” gambit is attached to the county’s high-stakes effort to phase out short-term rentals (STRs) operating without permits in residential apartment zones — a historic move designed to bring down purchase and rental prices, and free up housing stock for local residents.

item.title: Happy Camper for Monday, March 9, 2026
item.description: Congratulations, Ricky Castillo, on winning the Puerto Rico Open following rounds of 68, 68, 68 and 67 to finish 17-under par (FedEx points) at the Grand Reserve Golf Club. item.title: HerbieGives athletic stars chance to shine
item.description: Several hundred Kauai youth benefited from the personal appearance of Nate and Nick Herbig during the HerbieGives All Position Football camp at the Bryan J. Baptiste Memorial Sports Complex stadium on Saturday.

item.title: Maui vacation rentals face more challenges after setback
item.description: Owners of over 4,000 short-term vacation rental units on Maui and Molokai face more uncertainty after the Maui Planning Commission voted overwhelmingly against a proposal to create new hotel zoning districts that would allow owners to continue renting to tourists over local renters.

item.title: As Fukushima memories fade, Japan embraces a nuclear-powered future
item.description: IWAKI, Japan — Takuma Hashimoto was three years old when a massive earthquake and tsunami struck on March 11, 2011, triggering nuclear meltdowns at the Fukushima Daiichi plant just an hour’s drive from his home.

item.title: Agencies battle brush fire in Waimea
item.description: WAIMEA — The Kauai Fire Department responded to a brush fire Sunday in Waimea, near mile marker 2 of Waimea Canyon Drive.
